battle.name: 宋攻李成之戰
battle.brief: 建炎三年，江淮制置使與後來受命的招討使張俊先後出擊盤踞滁、池、江州的叛軍首領李成。戰事自十月滁州陷落、十二月沿江深入，至翌年三月筠州、江州與五月黃梅石幢坡接戰，叛軍始潰。十字弩在兩軍攻守中都居關鍵：守方置於城垛壓制登城者，攻城方則靠弩手齊射掩護步騎突進。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰雙方是南宋在淮西、江淮一線的官軍，與以李成為首的叛軍，背後分別站着金朝與其扶植的偽齊。叛軍首領李成原是北宋雄州歸信縣知縣，金兵南下佔據河北後，他以弓箭手的舊本領在淄川聚起數萬部眾，依附金朝，又兩度投靠南宋，最終歸附偽齊。李成沒有獨立建制，其部隊多為流民、散兵與攻掠所得的雜械，謀主是陶子思。南宋方面則有完整的指揮鏈：建炎二年十月，朝廷任命江淮制置使劉光世率軍征討，以王德為先鋒；建炎四年十二月，又以神武右軍都統制張俊為江淮招討使，把神武前軍王𤫙、神武後軍陳思恭與通泰鎮撫使岳飛各部一併調歸其節制。金朝自身在這一條戰線上兵不多，主要靠自北而南的騎兵施壓：建炎三年底金軍渡江南下，牽動全局，令李成改向淮西與江西擴張，也令南宋朝廷急於平定江淮。金人扶植的偽齊則以名分接納叛軍，作為牽制南宋江淮的棋子。整體而言，這是一場叛軍、南宋朝廷與傀儡政權三方糾纏的地方性戰爭，戰場縱貫淮南、淮西、鄱陽湖與贛江下游。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Southern Song's armies in the Huaiwest and Jiang-Huai lines, and the rebel force led by Li Cheng, with the Jin dynasty behind the rebels and the Jin-sponsored puppet state of Qi behind the rebels' formal titles. Li Cheng had originally been the magistrate of Guixin County in Xiong Prefecture of the Northern Song; after the Jin armies moved south and took northern China he gathered tens of thousands of followers at Zichuan using the skills of his old trade as an archer, attached himself to the Jin, surrendered to the Southern Song twice, and finally took refuge with the puppet state of Qi. Li Cheng had no independent establishment: his troops were a mixture of displaced people, disbanded soldiers and odd weapons taken in raids, and his adviser was Tao Zisi. The Song side, by contrast, had a proper chain of command. In the tenth month of Jianyan 2 (1128) the court appointed Liu Guangshi, Military Commissioner for the Jiang and Huai, to lead the punitive expedition, with Wang De as vanguard. In the twelfth month of Jianyan 4 (1130) it made Zhang Jun, commander of the Right Division of the Divine Might Army, the Inspector-General of the Jiang and Huai, and placed the Divine Might Vanguard under Wang (Yin), the Divine Might Rear Guard under Chen Sigong, and the Tongtai Pacification Commissioner Yue Fei all under his command. The Jin committed few troops of their own to this line; their weight came from cavalry pressing from the north, and it became decisive when the Jin crossed the Yangtze at the end of Jianyan 3 (1129). That crossing unsettled the whole region, pushed Li Cheng to expand westward into Huaiwest and southward into Jiangxi, and forced the Southern Song court to rush a punitive apparatus into the field. The puppet state of Qi, which the Jin had raised, took the rebels in and gave them names and standing, and functioned as a piece meant to tie down the Song's Jiang-Huai forces. In short this was a regional war in which rebels, a retreating court and a puppet regime all pulled on the same armed men, fought along a line running from the Huai valley through Huaiwest to Lake Poyang and the lower Gan River.
people: 核心人物是叛軍首領李成。他是河北雄縣歸信縣人，北宋末年以弓箭手的驍勇聞名，做過歸信縣知縣；金兵佔河北後在淄川聚眾，謀主陶子思進言勸他起事，隨後轉戰河南、淮南。李成用兵狠而多變：建炎二年八月渡黃河南下，攻掠宿州、虹縣，同年十月被江淮制置使劉光世與先鋒王德在上蔡西南驛口橋擊敗，逃奔新息再戰又敗，謀主陶子思被擒，本人率殘部轉攻淄州，最後因糧盡而退。建炎三年十月，李成渡淮攻破滁州，殺知州向子伋；十二月分兵三路，都統制胡選攻池州，副統制馬進渡江攻江州，自己率軍攻湖口，一舉佔領江淮十餘州軍。南宋方面，劉光世是建炎二年十月受命的江淮制置使，王德為其先鋒，驛口橋與新息兩陣都靠先鋒先鋒接敵方才扭轉局面；建炎四年十二月，張俊以神武右軍都統制出任江淮招討使，節制王𤫙、陳思恭與岳飛。紹興元年二月張俊進至洪州，李成派馬進屯守贛江西岸、邵友自奉新南下攻陷筠州與臨江軍。張俊入洪州後偃旗息鼓月餘，只令王𤫙在長江中閱習水軍，馬進以為宋軍怯戰而鬆懈。三月初七，岳飛自請為先鋒，率先部過贛江突擊馬進軍右翼，中軍統制楊沂中自贛江上游渡江，兩軍夾擊；岳飛又親率二百餘騎先出誘敵，馬進見宋軍兵少揮軍出戰，張俊命楊沂中、陳思恭兩軍同出山後，馬進軍大敗，被俘八千餘人，張俊怕降卒再叛，命陳思恭將其全部殺死。馬進退守江州，李成命部將商元在奉新樓子莊草北設伏，伏敗後奔蘄州，五月張俊進抵黃梅縣石幢坡，李成合胡選等軍號稱十萬據險阻擊，張俊以游卒佯動牽制，親率主力強攻奪取險要，李成勢窮，奔投偽齊。紹興三年李成進攻襄陽等地，終為岳飛所敗，襄陽府、鄧州、隨州、郢州、唐州、信陽軍六郡悉復。
peopleEn: The central figure is Li Cheng, the rebel commander. A native of Guixin County in Xiong, present-day Xiongxian in Hebei, he had made a name as a bowman who was daring and ferocious and had served as magistrate of his county in the last years of the Northern Song. After the Jin took the north he raised a following at Zichuan, where his adviser Tao Zisi argued that the time had come to rise, and from there he campaigned through southern Henan and the Huai valley. His methods were savage and opportunistic. In the eighth month of Jianyan 2 (1128) he crossed the Yellow River and raided Suzhou prefecture and Hong County; in the tenth month of the same year Liu Guangshi, Military Commissioner for the Jiang and Huai, and his vanguard Wang De broke him at the post-bridge south-west of Shangcai. He fled to Xinsi, was beaten again there, and Tao Zisi was taken prisoner. Li himself turned on Zichuan with the remnants, failed to take it and withdrew when his supplies ran out. In the tenth month of Jianyan 3 (1129) he crossed the Huai, carried Chuzhou and killed its governor Xiang Ziji. In the twelfth month he split his force three ways: the commander Hu Xuan against Chizhou, the deputy commander Ma Jin across the Yangtze against Jiangzhou, and himself against Hukou, in the process seizing more than ten prefectures and circuits across the Huai and the Yangtze. On the Song side, Liu Guangshi was the Military Commissioner appointed in the tenth month of Jianyan 2 and Wang De was his vanguard; it was the vanguard that broke the first two actions, at the post-bridge and at Xinsi. In the twelfth month of Jianyan 4 (1130) Zhang Jun, commander of the Right Division of the Divine Might Army, was appointed Inspector-General of the Jiang and Huai, with Wang (Yin), Chen Sigong and Yue Fei under him. In the second month of Shaoxing 1 (1131) Zhang Jun reached Hongzhou, where Li Cheng sent Ma Jin to hold the west bank of the Gan River and Shao You southward from Fengxin to take Junzhou and Linjiang. Zhang Jun then entered Hongzhou and lay low for more than a month, ordering only that Wang (Yin) drill his men in the water on the Yangtze; Ma Jin read the stillness as fear and relaxed his guard. On the seventh day of the third month Yue Fei asked to be vanguard, led his own troops across the Gan and struck Ma Jin's right flank, while the central commander Yang Yizhong crossed further upstream, so that the two wings closed on the enemy. Yue Fei then rode out with a little over two hundred horsemen to draw the enemy in; Ma Jin, seeing how few Song troops were in front of him, committed his army, and Zhang Jun sent Yang Yizhong and Chen Sigong out behind the hill to strike from the rear. Ma Jin's army was destroyed and more than eight thousand men were taken. Zhang Jun, fearing that surrendered men would rise again, had Chen Sigong kill them all. Ma Jin withdrew to Jiangzhou, where Li Cheng left him to hold the city while he led the main body back, and his officer Shang Yuan lay in ambush north of Louzizhuang at Fengxin. After that ambush was broken Li fell back on Qizhou. In the fifth month Zhang Jun reached Huangmei county and attacked at Shizhuangpo, where Li Cheng had gathered Hu Xuan and other troops who claimed to number a hundred thousand and held the high ground. Zhang Jun sent light troops to feign an attack, drew the enemy's attention, then led the main body uphill and took the position by force. Li Cheng had no course left and fled to the puppet state of Qi. In Shaoxing 3 (1133) he attacked Xiangyang and other places and was finally beaten by Yue Fei, who recovered the six circuits of Xiangzhou fu, Dengzhou, Suizhou, Yingzhou, Tangzhou and Xinyang.
kits: 這件十字弩在宋金之際的位置很明確：它不是野戰主力，而是守城與陣前壓制的專用兵器。弩手多編在步軍前鋒，以定距齊射壓制對方弓手與城頭射角；裝填一次需時，射速遠遜長弓，所以在開闊的野地上必須配合長弓、箭袋手與持牌持矛的步兵，掩護騎兵突進。守城一方則把弩置於城垛、敵樓與城門通道之後，趁敵兵逼近城下、弓箭俯射角度受限之際，擊其密集隊形。叛軍攻城多用雲梯、穴城與火矢，雲梯逼近牆根時，牆上的弩手居高臨下，射斷梯兵、覆蓋登城點，是守方最划算的一手。本戰役裡弩的兩個關鍵位置都在城牆：建炎三年滁州、池州、江州、湖口一線，兩軍攻守數度易手，弩手在城頭的密度直接決定一座城能守多久；而宋軍在黃梅石幢坡仰攻險要時，叛軍據高臨下，宋軍先以游卒與弩手前牽，再令步卒攀險而上，弩的齊射節奏必須緊接突進，否則压制一空，弩陣就失去作用。除弩之外，宋軍尚有長弓與硬弓、長槍、刀盾，以及京師西軍出身的騎兵，江上另備舟師，張俊入洪州時曾令王𤫙在長江中閱習水軍；叛軍則多為攻掠所得的雜械與鄉兵器械，攻城靠雲梯穴城，野戰靠人數與突襲；金軍南下時以鐵騎與硬箭為主。
kitsEn: This crossbow held a clearly defined place in the Song military order of the time. It was not a field-fighting arm but a specialist in defence and in pre-assault suppression. Crossbowmen were commonly attached to the front of the infantry, delivering massed shots at a fixed distance to hold down the enemy's archers and the firing positions on a wall. Reloading took time and the rate of fire was far below that of the longbow, so in open country the crossbow line had to be covered by longbows, quiver-men, spearmen and shield-bearers, and served to screen a cavalry charge. A defending force instead posted its crossbows behind the battlements, the gate towers and the passages behind the gates, and let them shoot into the crowded files of an enemy who had come within bowshot below the wall, where the defenders' own archers could not shoot freely. The rebels attacked with scaling ladders, sapping and fire arrows, and once a ladder stood at the foot of the wall the crossbowmen above could shoot the ladder men and sweep the point of ascent, which was the cheapest answer a defender had. In this campaign the crossbow's two decisive positions were both on the wall. Along the Chuzhou, Chizhou, Jiangzhou and Hukou line in Jianyan 3 (1129) the towns changed hands repeatedly, and the number of crossbowmen posted on the ramparts decided how long a city held. When the Song army attacked uphill at Shizhuangpo in Huangmei the rebels held the high ground, so the Song first used light troops to feign and crossbowmen to pin the enemy, and only then sent infantry up the slope; the rhythm of the volley had to be welded to the assault, because the moment the suppression lapsed the crossbow line was worthless. Besides the crossbow, the Song had longbows and heavier bows, long spears, sabres and shields, and cavalry of the western army trained at the capital; they also had river craft on the Yangtze, and Zhang Jun had Wang (Yin) drill the water troops in mid-river on reaching Hongzhou. The rebels were equipped mostly with odd weapons taken in raids and the gear of village levies, using ladders and sapping against towns and weight of numbers and surprise in the field. The Jin, when they came south, relied on their iron cavalry and their hard-shafted arrows.
tactics: 李成的戰法是流動與奪城並重：他靠渡河、順勢轉戰、避實擊虛，在江淮之間反覆找空隙，遇大軍則散，遇空城則合；攻不下就換地方，糧盡即轉身。兩度投宋又兩度叛離，說明他並不打算守土，只打算用城池與糧食養兵，待金軍或官軍主力南下時再取空隙。南宋這邊的戰術則由張俊在紹興元年集結完成：他先在洪州偃旗息鼓月餘，只令王𤫙於長江中閱習水軍，縱敵鬆懈，再於三月初七分三路動手——岳飛率先鋒過贛江直插右翼，楊沂中自贛江上游渡江，張俊親率中軍策應，夾擊馬進於筠州。馬進背依筠河列陣，岳飛率二百餘騎出挑戰，誘其傾巢出擊，楊沂中與陳思恭兩軍同出山後，形成前後夾擊之勢。追擊途中商元於奉新樓子莊草北設伏，張俊見山險路狹，不硬攻正面，改令步卒由小路潛登山頂，先破伏兵再順勢下壓，攻入江州，馬進棄城而逃。五月黃梅石幢坡，李成據險高處號稱十萬阻擊，張俊再以游卒佯動牽制，主力乘隙強攻險要，一鼓奪之。整體看，這輪攻防裡弩手的用法很清楚：守城時居高齊射、逼退雲梯最有效；野戰中裝填太慢，必須讓弩隊以齊射壓住敵弓手，緊接由步騎趁隙突進，否則弩陣一旦被貼近就會失去作用。
tacticsEn: Li Cheng fought by movement and by seizing towns at the same time. He crossed rivers, turned with the current, struck where the enemy was not, and hunted for openings along the Huai and the Yangtze; when he met a massed army he dispersed, when he found an empty town he closed up. When a siege dragged on he moved elsewhere, and when his food ran out he turned away. His twice surrendering to the Song and twice rebelling again shows that he had no intention of holding territory: he meant to use cities and grain to keep his men in being, and to take fresh openings whenever the Jin or the Song field armies moved south. The Song tactics, by contrast, were assembled by Zhang Jun in the first year of Shaoxing. He lay quiet at Hongzhou for more than a month, ordering only that Wang (Yin) drill the water troops in mid-river, letting the enemy grow slack, and then on the seventh day of the third month he moved in three parts: Yue Fei as vanguard crossing the Gan and driving into Ma Jin's right flank, Yang Yizhong crossing higher up the river, and Zhang Jun himself with the central army covering the movement, closing on Ma Jin at Junzhou. Ma Jin deployed with his back to the Jun River; Yue Fei rode out with a little over two hundred horsemen to provoke him into committing everything, and Yang Yizhong and Chen Sigong came out from behind the hill so that the enemy was taken front and rear. On the pursuit, Shang Yuan lay in ambush north of Louzizhuang at Fengxin. Zhang Jun, seeing the narrow road and the steep ground, refused to attack head-on and instead sent infantry up a side path to the ridge, broke the ambush and came down upon the enemy, entering Jiangzhou and forcing Ma Jin to abandon the city. In the fifth month, at Shizhuangpo in Huangmei, Li Cheng held the heights with a claimed hundred thousand men; Zhang Jun again used light troops to feign, drew the enemy's attention, and led the main body uphill to take the position in one rush. Read as a whole, the campaign makes the role of the crossbowmen plain. On the wall, massed shots from above were the cheapest way to beat back ladders. In the field the slow reload meant the crossbow line had to put down the enemy archers with a volley and then let infantry and horsemen rush through the gap, because once the crossbowmen were reached they were useless.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。李成在河北起事時聚眾數萬，兵力主力來自淄川一帶的流民與散兵；建炎二年八月渡黃河南下，兩個月後已能擾動宿州、虹縣一線。同年十月李成在驛口橋、新息連敗兩陣，丟失謀主陶子思，攻淄州又久攻不克、糧盡而退，這是他第一次主力崩解。建炎三年十月他渡淮破滁州，十二月進軍池州、江州、湖口，一度控制江淮十餘州軍，是其勢力頂點。紹興元年二月，張俊率神武前軍、後軍與岳飛部進至洪州；三月初七筠州之戰，馬進部被俘八千餘人，張俊以擔心降卒再叛為由，令陳思恭全部殺死；岳飛出挑時所部僅二百餘騎。五月石幢坡之戰，李成集合胡選等軍號稱十萬，實際戰兵當遠少於此數，敗後奔偽齊。紹興三年李成再攻襄陽，為岳飛所敗，襄陽府、鄧州、隨州、郢州、唐州、信陽軍六郡悉復。時間上，從建炎二年八月起兵算起，到紹興元年五月戰事基本平定，前後約兩年九個月，中間還被金軍南下一度打斷。李成至死六十九歲，一一三七年偽齊被廢後他被金朝收編為將，一一四〇年隨完顏宗弼攻陷洛陽，任河南府尹，後改真定府尹。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. When Li Cheng rose in the north he gathered tens of thousands, drawn mostly from displaced people and disbanded soldiers around Zichuan. In the eighth month of Jianyan 2 (1128) he crossed the Yellow River, and within two months he was disturbing the line of Suzhou prefecture and Hong County. In the tenth month of that year he lost two actions in succession, at the post-bridge and at Xinsi, gave up his adviser Tao Zisi to the enemy, failed to take Zichuan after a long siege and withdrew when his food ran out; this was the first collapse of his main body. In the tenth month of Jianyan 3 (1129) he crossed the Huai and carried Chuzhou; in the twelfth month he advanced on Chizhou, Jiangzhou and Hukou and for a time held more than ten circuits across the Huai and the Yangtze, which was the height of his strength. In the second month of Shaoxing 1 (1131) Zhang Jun brought the Divine Might vanguard and rear guard and Yue Fei's troops down to Hongzhou. In the action at Junzhou on the seventh day of the third month more than eight thousand of Ma Jin's men were taken prisoner, and Zhang Jun, on the ground that surrendered men might rise again, had Chen Sigong kill them all. When Yue Fei rode out to provoke the enemy he had a little over two hundred horsemen with him. In the fighting at Shizhuangpo in the fifth month Li Cheng brought together Hu Xuan and others who claimed a hundred thousand; the actual fighting force must have been far smaller, and he fled to the puppet state of Qi afterwards. In Shaoxing 3 (1133) he attacked Xiangyang once more, was beaten by Yue Fei, and the six circuits of Xiangzhou fu, Dengzhou, Suizhou, Yingzhou, Tangzhou and Xinyang were recovered. In time, from the rising of the eighth month of Jianyan 2 to the general settling of the fighting in the fifth month of Shaoxing 1 is about two years and nine months, interrupted once by the Jin crossing the Yangtze. Li Cheng was sixty-nine years old when he died. In 1137, when the puppet state of Qi was abolished, he was taken into Jin service as a general; in 1140 he followed Wanyan Zongbi in the capture of Luoyang and was made governor of Luoyang, later governor of Zhending.
cause: 起事的原因有多層。李成本是北宋雄州歸信縣的知縣，北宋末年的亂局已讓地方武力鬆散；金兵南下佔據河北，郡縣官軍散解，他以弓箭手的舊本領在淄川聚起部眾，謀主陶子思看出宋廷無力北顧，勸他趁隙取事，叛亂自此爆開。建炎二年朝廷南渡，江淮正當兩軍反覆拉鋸之地，官軍主力多在荊襄與江上，江北的所謂義軍與散兵名號混雜，招撫與討伐並用，誰出價高誰就倒戈——李成兩投南宋又終附偽齊，正是這個結構的產物。金朝則有意縱容，利用叛軍牽制南宋江淮兵力：建炎三年底金軍大舉渡江南下，淮南人心浮動，李成趁勢北進滁州，又分兵深入池州、江州，把江淮攪成一片狼藉，宋廷被迫把剛組建起來的招討體系投入這場戰爭。說到底，李成的叛亂既是金人南侵的副產品，也是南宋初期軍事體制混亂的一個徵兆。
causeEn: The outbreak had several layers of cause. Li Cheng had been the magistrate of Guixin County in Xiong Prefecture, and the disorder of the last years of the Northern Song had already loosened local military authority. When the Jin moved south and took the north, the prefectural and county troops fell apart, and Li used the skills of his old trade as a bowman to gather a following at Zichuan. His adviser Tao Zisi read that the Song court had no strength to look north and urged him to seize the moment, and the rebellion broke out. When the court moved south in Jianyan 2 (1128), the Jiang and Huai became the hinge on which the two sides dragged, with most of the Song's field strength committed in Jingxiang and on the river, and with the so-called loyal troops and disbanded soldiers in the north indistinguishable in name. Pacification and suppression were used together, and whichever side paid more owned the men; Li's twice surrendering to the Song and finally attaching himself to the puppet state of Qi was the product of exactly that structure. The Jin had reason to let the rebellion run, using it to pin down the Song's Jiang-Huai forces: when their armies crossed the Yangtze in force at the end of Jianyan 3 (1129), the Huai valley was unsettled, Li Cheng moved north into Chuzhou and sent detachments deep into Chizhou and Jiangzhou, and the river and Huai country was left in confusion. The court was therefore obliged to commit the punitive apparatus it had only just created. In the end, Li Cheng's rising was both a by-product of the Jin invasion and a symptom of the dislocated military command of the early Southern Song.
impact: 這場戰爭對南宋的傷害遠大於對叛軍本身。李成在江淮盤踞一年有餘，先後佔領滁、池、江、湖口等十餘州軍，淮南的漕運線與北向通道幾乎斷絕，南宋在江淮只剩幾個據點的兵備。為平叛，宋廷把剛組成的神武軍、王𤫙與陳思恭兩軍、岳飛的通泰鎮撫使部一併撥給張俊節制，等於用一次戰爭換來一位能統合諸軍的招討使，也把岳飛推上前線——自請先鋒、夜襲贛江、率二百餘騎誘敵，都是他日後嶄露頭角的開端；紹興三年收復襄陽六郡，更使岳家軍之名漸為人知。平叛之後張俊權重一時，兵柄在手，終為朝廷所忌，後來在秦檜主導的論和戰之議中被罷兵權，內部由此埋下裂痕。李成本人則由叛軍首領變成金朝將領，一一三七年偽齊被廢、一一四〇年隨完顏宗弼陷洛陽，坐在河南府尹的位置上——這是南北兩個政權在淮上拉鋒的縮影：對金而言是收編有用的武力，對宋而言是拖了三年才拔掉的釘子。軍器層面也留下一課：弩在守城與陣前齊射的價值遠高於野戰，攻防節奏與器械選擇互相牽動。
impactEn: The damage this war did to the Southern Song was far greater than the damage it did to the rebels. Li Cheng held the Huai and the Jiang for more than a year, taking Chuzhou, Chizhou, Jiangzhou, Hukou and more than ten circuits in all, and the Huai region's grain route and its northward lanes were cut almost to nothing, leaving the Song with garrison rights in a handful of posts along the river. To end it, the court handed the newly raised Divine Might Army, the vanguard of Wang (Yin), the rear guard of Chen Sigong and Yue Fei's Tongtai pacification force over to Zhang Jun to command, so that one war bought the court an Inspector-General able to weld several armies together, and at the same time pushed Yue Fei to the front: asking for the van, striking the Gan by night, riding out with a little over two hundred horsemen to draw the enemy, all of it the beginning of the reputation he made later, and the recovery of the six Xiangyang circuits in Shaoxing 3 (1133) made the name of his army known. After the pacification Zhang Jun's power stood at its height; with the army in his hands he came to be distrusted by the court, and was later stripped of his command in the debate on war and peace led by Qin Hui, leaving a fracture inside the Song military from that point on. Li Cheng himself turned from rebel leader into a general of the Jin: with the puppet state of Qi abolished in 1137 and Luoyang taken in 1140 under Wanyan Zongbi, he ended up sitting in the office of governor of Luoyang. That is the whole argument between north and south in miniature: to the Jin a useful body of men to be absorbed, to the Song a spike that took three years to pull out. On the weapons side it left a lesson too, for the value of the crossbow in defence and in massed fire before an assault was far higher than its value in the open field, and the rhythm of attack and defence was bound up with the choice of equipment.
result: 結果是官軍逐步收復，李成兩度敗亡。建炎二年十月驛口橋與新息兩陣失利，是李成第一次被打回江北；建炎三年十月破滁州、十二月深入池州江州，則是他最後一次大規模擴張。紹興元年二月張俊入洪州，三月七日筠州之戰馬進被俘八千餘人、二十八日江州收復，四月追擊商元於奉新樓子莊，五月進抵黃梅石幢坡攻破險要，李成勢窮，奔投偽齊，宋軍乘勝收復被佔的淮西各州縣。紹興三年李成再攻襄陽，岳飛擊敗之，收復襄陽府、鄧州、隨州、郢州、唐州、信陽軍六郡，江淮與襄漢的通道重開。李成其後為金朝收編，一一三七年偽齊廢、一一四〇年隨完顏宗弼入洛陽，先後任河南府尹與真定府尹，終老六十九歲。對宋廷而言，叛亂是平了，但李成帶走的兩年、耗掉的江淮，以及為了平叛而形成的招討使集權，都留給了後來的南渡政局。
resultEn: The result was a slow recovery by the government forces and the ruin of Li Cheng in two separate rounds. The defeats at the post-bridge and at Xinsi in the tenth month of Jianyan 2 were the first time he was thrown back across the river; the taking of Chuzhou in the tenth month of Jianyan 3 and the deep push into Chizhou and Jiangzhou in the twelfth month were his last large expansion. In the second month of Shaoxing 1 (1131) Zhang Jun entered Hongzhou; on the seventh day of the third month Ma Jin lost more than eight thousand men at Junzhou, and on the twenty-eighth the city of Jiangzhou was recovered; in the fourth month Shang Yuan was chased out of his ambush at Louzizhuang near Fengxin; and in the fifth month the Song army reached Huangmei, took Shizhuangpo by assault, and Li Cheng, with nothing left to try, fled to the puppet state of Qi, after which the Song took back the Huaiwest circuits that had been lost. In Shaoxing 3 (1133) Li Cheng attacked Xiangyang again and was beaten by Yue Fei, who recovered the six circuits of Xiangzhou fu, Dengzhou, Suizhou, Yingzhou, Tangzhou and Xinyang, reopening the road between the Huai and the Xiang and Han. Li Cheng was afterwards taken into Jin service; when the puppet state of Qi was abolished in 1137 and he entered Luoyang with Wanyan Zongbi in 1140, he served as governor of Luoyang and later of Zhending, dying at sixty-nine. For the court the rebellion was over, but the two years it took, the exhaustion of the Huai region, and the concentration of command in the hands of an Inspector-General created to end it all remained on the account of the Southern Song that followed.
